explanation: OEIS A034693, C. Greathouse: 'I conjecture the opposite: a(n) / (log n log log n) is unbounded.' The formal statement says the range of n ↦ a(n)/(log n · log log n) is not bounded above. The small-n values (where the denominator is 0 or negative) are finitely many and do not affect unboundedness. Faithful.
